morphology.pattern_note: 作为人名整体记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分；所列音节和读音为参考读法，实际读音以本人使用为准。

senses.zh_definition: 妮莎：人名，也可作昵称；不是已核实的标准马来语普通名词。
senses.en_definition: Nisha, a personal name or nickname; not verified here as a standard Malay common noun.
senses.ms_definition: Nama orang atau nama panggilan yang ditulis dengan huruf awal besar, iaitu Nisha.
senses.nuances: 在马来语句子中按专有名词使用，写作 Nisha。马来西亚确有人使用这一昵称，但不能据此将它解释为马来语的“夜晚”。此处释义为人名用法说明，并非 DBP 官方释义。[马来西亚人名使用实例](https://www.kosmo.com.my/2024/08/04/pilihan-saya-lelaki-tinggi-sopan-santun/)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Nisha akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: Nisha 将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Nisha will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nisha dah sampai kat kafe ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Nisha sudah sampai di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Nisha arrived at the café yet?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语形式。
kat 在此相当于表示地点的 di。
句末 ke 构成口语是非问句。

messages.ms_spoken: Nisha dah sampai kat kafe ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Nisha sudah sampai di kafe?
messages.en: Has Nisha arrived at the café yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat dalam je. Jom masuk.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah sampai dan sedang menunggu di dalam. Mari kita masuk.
messages.zh: 到了，她就在里面等。走，进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, she's waiting inside. Let's go in.

etymology.historical_story: Nisha is associated with Sanskrit niśā, meaning night, and occurs as a personal name in South Asian naming traditions. In Malaysia, however, Nisha may also be a nickname derived from a longer name. These possibilities must remain separate: a Sanskrit association does not establish the origin of every individual bearer’s name or a Malay meaning of night. [Sanskrit reference](https://sanskritguru.srihayavadhana.com/dictionary/nisha/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Nisha 记成通讯录里的“妮莎”：认人名，不把它当作 malam（夜晚）的替代词。
